description: Activate when: user says 'our growth is stalling and we don't know why,' 'product and marketing are arguing about whose fault it is,' 'where is our funnel breaking,' 'pirate metrics,' or 'acquisition vs activation vs retention.' Also activate for: designing end-to-end metrics for a new product, building a shared instrumentation framework across teams. Do NOT activate when: the product has no users yet (use lean-startup instead), or the bottleneck is already obvious and obvious to fix. More: deciqai.com/c/aarrr-pirate-metrics
